notes.title: Welcome
notes.content:
[h3]Particularly wish to welcome all new players and hope they have a great game!
[/h3]

[b]What to expect from Avalom?
[/b]
[i]In addition to what has already been presented, Avalom will undergo constant monthly updates with extra content based on events that players will decide the actions of the world that affect their region, economy, army and challenges. All of this will be decided through achievements on the steam which players have decided to help finish or not. Depending on the occasion and event players can favor for it to happen and thus extra content will be added bringing benefits such as new sets of armor, items, boss, dungeon and so on.[/i]

[b]Improvement:
[/b]
[i]There has been an improvement in HUD and placements;[/i]
[i]Adding mouse options;
[/i]

[b]Fixes:
[/b]
[i]Fixed minor bugs without major importance;[/i]

notes.title: NEW PATHS
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39032515/c4a261dfbaa483f2aa5e3c7a7dc40789445dcd8f.png[/img]

[h3]New Content:[/h3]

[b]New skill tree system;[/b]

[i]A new skill tree allows players to build the character as they wish, following a path between them and combining as they wish with their evolution points.[/i]

[b]New Paths and Orders;[/b]

[i]Hunter's Path that uses unique abilities like bows that deal a lot of individual damage from a distance.
[/i]
[i]Path of Tactics that uses its leadership in combat to improve its war allies by managing combat providing bonus effects for everyone.
[/i]
[i]Summoning Path that uses creatures from other planes to assist in combat with more abilities.[/i]

[i]Primal Path that utilizes natural magic and controlling nature to its advantage and maintaining control in combat.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39032515/350f5283c0ae46afcbb53723fe0361c2a1444b0d.png[/img]

[b]Reincarnation System (End Game);[/b]

[i]When the character reaches its peak around 96 points of evolution, it can spend its life and reincarnate again with improvement of all its stats, being able to perform up to 10x this procedure.[/i]

[b]Difficulty System (End Game);[/b]

[b]As the character reincarnates the monsters' difficulty system will automatically be assigned, this applies in multiplayer mode to which everyone involved will be linked.[/b]


Small Bug Fixes...

notes.title: PLANE ABYSSAL
NEWS AND IMPROVEMENTS
ALLIANCES OF THE KINGDOM!
Game Master
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39032515/3373c86b03a58aa5d44698a2b1f391165e9115ec.png[/img]

[h1] Game Master [/ h1]

[b] Currently the game has approximately +200 hours of content and I am already preparing for the end game. The game will have a lot of content even after its final version, the possibility of content is endless telling several stories, in fact these stories will be coming from the updates that will come from this one. [/b]

Corrections:

There were several corrections to make the game in its most stable version, I can say that this version is already a preparation for the official release. Recalling that the map is giant with possibilities to travel to others, thus having gaps that will be used for new content even after its final launch. Next update the chest will be removed from the game to avoid exploit or any annoyance.

Current Content:

Today the game offers a complete pen and paper role-playing system that the player is truly free to be or follow as they please. As always, it is ideal for each player to see the options on how to play and to understand a little about the rule system and basic tutorials.

[i] All characters have been improved in their design; [/i]
[i] Race System; [/i]
[i] Improved professions:
Explorer has a chance to get extra treasure chest beyond the normal monsters, for those who like to create their equipment the creative profession collects material items from all monsters, the scholar profession can now create rune and golems equipment as companions and for In the end the merchant receives a reward from merchants for each mission he completes allowing him to use a special market in the trading post. [/i]

[i] Item creation system with hundreds of possibilities; [/i]
[i] Passive and Active abilities that allow different character constructions;
[/i]
[i] Order skills that further focus the character such as: Necromancers, assassins, archmage and berserkers; [/i]
[i] System for creating your fort as a base of operations, the player can build a fortress from scratch and see his entire system evolving and interacting with the world of Avalom; [/i]
[i] Companions, mounts and pet system;
[/i]

In addition to the above, there are many things in Avalom that the player will discover, requiring a lot of exploration in a vast world and strategies to fight dozens of enemies and bosses receiving glorious rewards and discover the secrets behind the whole plot.

Access our [url=https://discord.com/invite/x8fEq9u3se]Discord - Avalom[/url] and follow the news closely taking all doubts!
